villagemaster/30704.htm.text: High Prefect Garvarentz: I am High Prefect Garvarentz, and I teach high level Orc warriors and magicians by the will of Pa'agrio, the father of eternal fire. Why have you come to see me?

links.text: Listen to information about second class transfer.

Q00344_1000YearsTheEndOfLamentation/3070.text: High Prefect Gavarentz: This necklace and statue prove that what you say is true. Last night I dreamed of an Orc. His large body was covered with scars and he was drenched in what must have been his enemy's blood. He gave me this necklace... Thank you, young traveler. Now I shall give the necklace …

High Prefect Gavarentz: I have entrusted the amulet necklace to my daughter, who I have sent north to the Orc Fortress. She will wear the necklace in battle. I pray the mighty spirit of her ancestor will watch over her.
